messages.author: e0e7ecc3a1b52684
messages.subject: facet opts
parts:
I'm trying to set the axis line to be the same for all facet panels; specifically, I want a solid black line on the x and y axes for all panels and as written only the far left and bottom panels show lines.  I've scoured Hadley's book and a small fraction of the internet with no luck.  Anyone know an "opts" statement or another workaround which can allow me do this?

Here's my code, and the sample output is attached:

load("offsets.rda")
plotfacet<-function(){
        p2<-qplot(cha,log10(abs(offset)),data=df)
        p2+facet_grid(
                mag ~ sta
        )+
        aes(
                colour=event,
                shape=cha
        )+
                scale_x_discrete(
                name="BSM channel",breaks=c("BS0","BS1","BS2","BS3"),labels=c(0,1,2,3)
        )+
                scale_y_continuous(
        )+
                opts(
                legend.position="none",
                panel.background=theme_blank(),
                panel.grid.major=theme_blank(),
                panel.grid.minor=theme_blank(),
                axis.line=theme_segment()
        )
}
plotfacet()

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: facet opts
parts:
Hi Andrew,

This isn't possible with options, but you could try drawing the
segments yourself. Something like the following should work:

+ annotate("segment", x = -Inf, xend = Inf, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf)

Hadley
